title: Perfect 🤩
text:
Absolutely amazing experience!! 
The best captain, best service and fantastic views. Stopped to swim and enjoyed every second!
Had some freshly made sangria and nice snacks. 
Definitely doing this again next time we are in Barcelona.
Worth every penny - just go and enjoy it!
